Name: Pierre Rewritten and Improved
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

Pierre is one of my least favorite characters in the game. He is a greedy snake who always takes credit for the farmer's work and doesn't think about anything other than getting rich and making it big.

This mod gives his personality a much needed improvement by rewriting and adjusting his dialogue. He is now a shop owner for the community, a loving husband and father (if a bit overprotective) and gives credit where it's due.

[size=5]Mod Compatibility:[/size]

[size=4]Mods that edit Pierre's vanilla dialogue, his 6 heart event, Abigail's 6 heart event, and his Y1 Winter visit may not be compatible.[/size]

[size=4]Confirmed Compatible:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] - Pierre and Caroline's Mature Events are disabled due to them not fitting the intended nature of this mod. One of the Wizard's lines is slightly rewritten.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20028]Less Greedy Pierre[/url] - My version of Pierre's Special Order is disabled if you have this installed.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens[/url] - Pierre will address you by your intended title
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]

[size=4]Not Compatible:[/size]

This mod is not compatible with any mod that makes Pierre or Caroline romanceable and I have no intention of adding any. Also not compatible with any mod that pairs Pierre or Caroline with other characters.

Also not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29834]Piper - A Pierre Rewrite[/url], due to the fact that that mod is the same concept with different execution.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Pierre Rewritten and Improved into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Pierre Rewritten and Improved
Manifest.Description: Improves Pierre's personality by making him less of a greedy shop owner.
